answeredQuestions.initiative-name-and-description: AI agent providing whole-of-wealth customer profile insight, member movement analytics, FUM retention analysis, and next-best interaction recommendations for an Australian superannuation provider.
answeredQuestions.business-problem: Understand member behavior, identify attrition drivers, diagnose Funds Under Management (FUM) outflows, and deliver trend analysis to guide future customer interactions.

nextActions: Clarify regulatory classification of advice (General Advice vs Personal Advice vs intra-fund advice under Corporations Act / ASIC RG 244)
Clarify agent target user (Internal front-line staff / retention specialist co-pilot vs Direct-to-consumer digital agent)
Define Whole-of-Wealth data source boundaries and consent model (CDR / Open Banking / internal fund data)
Formulate SMART Business Goals (BG-001, BG-002) with FUM retention and member attrition metrics
